purpose: Exercise the first Stage2-P trajectory-response interface after the integrity-valid but semantically insensitive Stage2-L slice, without repairing upstream quality first.

architecture.trajectory_response: bounded residual applied after the native ORION trajectory

controlled_k_derivation.source: The existing Route147 mechanism-upper-bound cache supplies identical frozen ORION contexts and controlled spatial interventions.
controlled_k_derivation.relevant_k: on-path controlled map multiplied by oracle relevance 1.0
controlled_k_derivation.irrelevant_k: equal-area off-path controlled map multiplied by oracle relevance 0.05
controlled_k_derivation.view_shuffled_k: front controlled map moved to central rear and multiplied by oracle relevance 0.05

hard_stop_conditions: Any frozen input, protocol, preflight or launch hash differs.
A privileged task context, route, actor, TTC, collision or outcome value enters the forward path.
Zero K changes the native planning context or produces a nonzero trajectory residual.
A tensor, loss or gradient is non-finite.
A residual exceeds the fixed lateral or longitudinal bound.
An output artifact or tensor interface is missing or malformed.

downstream_policy.integrity_valid: Preserve the quality result and prepare one separately preregistered tiny CARLA engineering smoke.
downstream_policy.quality_failure: Carry the labeled result through the tiny runtime smoke; do not add epochs before completing the first slice.
downstream_policy.hard_failure: Stop and repair the incompatible interface before CARLA.

claim_boundary: A one-route controlled-K trajectory-interface smoke only. It cannot establish learned uncertainty, Stage2-L semantics, generalization, closed-loop benefit or safety.
